skill.label: トーンイントーン配色

derivationRule: Current official Grade 2 sample explicitly includes tone-in-tone as an identification target. ONCA, Plus Colors and FOLK independently agree on the nonvisual intersection used here: keep the tone the same and vary hue. Plus Colors additionally permits similar tones, but that broader allowance is not encoded because the other checked sources do not independently establish it. No image appearance, tone-map geometry, RGB/HEX, monitor color or unstated numeric boundary is inferred.

無彩色だけで構成する
questions.proposedAnswer: 同一トーンでまとめ、色相で変化をつける
questions.explanation: 確認した資料の共通部分は、同一トーンを統一軸にして色相で変化をつけることです。
